decision.explanation: Document D1S3 explicitly states that 'He was one of the sons of the Frankish king Clotaire I and Queen Aregund.' This directly identifies Clotaire I as the father of Chilperic I. Other candidates (Lothair I, Guntram, Gondioc, and Childeric II) refer to different individuals named Chilperic (e.g., Chilperic II of Burgundy or Chilperic II of Neustria) and are not relevant to the question about Chilperic I's father. The requested relation is resolved with the most direct and unambiguous source.
